title: Aha Entho Anandame – Sudhakar Rella Telugu Christian Song Lyrics
telugu: అహ ఎంతో ఎంతో ఆనందమే – యేసయ్య పుట్టాడని
అహ ఎంతో ఎంతో సంతోషమే – లోకరక్షకుడు వచ్చాడని
చీకటైనా నా జీవితాన – వెలుగు నింప వచ్చినాడే
english: Aha entho entho aanandhame – yesayya puttaadani
aha entho entho santhoshame – loka rakshakudu vacchaadani
cheekataina naa jeevithaana – velugu nimpa vacchinaade
maranaachayalo unna naaku – nithya jeevamiyya vacchinaade
intro: Aha Entho Anandame is the latest Christian Telugu Christmas song written & tuned by P Sunith & Bobby Jeevan, sung and music composed by Sudhakar Rella featuring Jessi D. This song was released on December 06, 2025 through Sudhakar Rella Olive Studios YouTube channel.
